name: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 42
description: Spinocerebellar ataxia-42 is an autosomal dominant neurologic disorder characterized predominantly by gait instability and additional cerebellar signs such as dysarthria, nystagmus, and saccadic pursuits. The age at onset and severity of the disorder is highly variable; it is slowly progressive (summary by Coutelier et al., 2015).
